PR - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/4925 My first pass at a proposal to harmonize Core EIPs across the EL+CL & their executable specs: https://notes.ethereum.org/@timbeiko/executable-eips Still lots to figure out, but it paints the broader picture. Not sure we'll have the time to discuss it on ACD this week given everything else, but we can do so 🔜 If this didn't have so many links in it, I might make an EIP out of it 😂 Based on my understanding of ERC vs EIP, 712 should be ERC 712 (not to be confused with ERC 721), but most everywhere I see it referred to as EIP 712. Maybe because it is still in "review"?
